brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 先让化简用两条定义把左边算出来；两边一样以后，用<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>接上<part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Let Simp work the left side out with the two definitions; once both sides are the same, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref> with <part-ref to="part:refl"></part-ref>.

t.zh: 定义也是改写规则：<part-ref to="lemma:simp"></part-ref>的规则里多了一组「定义」。<level-ref to="nl-plus"></level-ref>里手算的，可以交给它。
t.en: A definition is a rewrite rule too: <part-ref to="lemma:simp"></part-ref> now has a group of definitions among its rules. What <level-ref to="nl-plus"></level-ref> did by hand can be left to it.

after.zh: 在证明助手里，计算就是改写。
after.en: In a proof assistant, computing is rewriting.
